from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
from PIL import Image
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
root=Path.cwd();out=root/'sample/output/s11-public-scene-controls-20261009-001';out.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
intake=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-intake.json';rename=root/'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-rename.json'
r=json.loads(intake.read_text());ren=json.loads(rename.read_text());aliases={p['original_path']:p for p in ren['renames']}
lookup={}
for v in r['overview']['videos']:
 for f in v['frames']:lookup[(v['path'],f['frame_index'])]=dict(f,origin=[0,0],view='native_full_frame')
for v in r['temporal']['results']:
 for f in v['frames']:
  lookup.setdefault((v['path'],f['frame_index']),dict(f,origin=v['display_crop_xyxy'][:2],view='saved_display_crop'))
old=lambda suffix:next(k for k in aliases if suffix in k)
def source(kind,frame):
 p=lookup[(old(kind),frame)];assert sha(root/p['path'])==p['sha256'];return p
selection=[('s5-empty','water',0),('s5-inclined','water',822),('s5-settled','water',1643),('s6-empty','beer',0),('s6-forming','beer',146),('s6-layer','beer',436),('s7-empty','milk',0),('s7-pouring','milk',532),('s7-settled','milk',1063)]
pre=dict(schema='s11-public-scene-control-preflight-v1',base_head='2f5d814f1dab8201f28884d06dd8f2063fa5905d',purpose='Bind pre-detector scene/control roles and a new physical ambiguity; no operating-point fit or predictions.',inputs={str(intake.relative_to(root)):sha(intake),str(rename.relative_to(root)):sha(rename)},
 selection=[dict(case_id=case,video=aliases[old(kind)]['current_path'],frame_index=frame) for case,kind,frame in selection],
 rule='Use already exposed native intake frames for empty/filled/uncertain/cropped roles before model results. Agent interpretations remain provisional, all scalar/contour truth absent.',
 question='At sample5 27.194–27.661 s, is the large sloped upper boundary the real displaced water surface or an overlying splash sheet?',
 marker_scope='Display-only rectangle X[800,1110), Y[400,650); no traced contour, pixel truth or production mask.',
 partition='development',detector_run=False,model_fit=False,recipe_change=False)
for _,kind,frame in selection:
 p=source(kind,frame);pre['inputs'][p['path']]=p['sha256']
for frame in (815,822,829):
 p=source('water',frame);pre['inputs'][p['path']]=p['sha256']
for entry in aliases.values():
 p=root/entry['current_path'];assert sha(p)==entry['sha256_after'];pre['inputs'][entry['current_path']]=entry['sha256_after']
(out/'preflight.json').write_text(json.dumps(pre,indent=2)+'\n')
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(10.5,5.8),layout='constrained')
for ax,frame in zip(axes,(815,822,829),strict=True):
 p=source('water',frame);im=Image.open(root/p['path']);ox,oy=p['origin'];w,h=im.size
 ax.imshow(im,extent=(ox-.5,ox+w-.5,oy+h-.5,oy-.5),interpolation='nearest');ax.set_xlim(740,1160);ax.set_ylim(940,250)
 ax.set_xticks([]);ax.set_yticks([]);ax.set_title(f'{frame/(30000/1001):.3f} s / f{frame}')
 if frame==822:ax.add_patch(Rectangle((800,400),310,250,fill=False,edgecolor='#ff9c2b',lw=1.8))
fig.suptitle('sample5: physical role of the sloped upper water feature',fontsize=14)
fig.supxlabel('Orange box: approximate review region only. No detector prediction or exact contour label.',fontsize=10)
path=out/'sample5-inclined-surface-review.png';fig.savefig(path,dpi=150);plt.close(fig)
# One control overview per source, using the earlier frozen display crop.
boxes={'water':[740,250,1160,1080],'beer':[200,0,2500,1440],'milk':[760,240,1480,1060]}
for kind in boxes:
 fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(12,6.4),layout='constrained')
 for ax,(case,_,frame) in zip(axes,[s for s in selection if s[1]==kind],strict=True):
  p=source(kind,frame);im=Image.open(root/p['path']);assert p['origin']==[0,0]
  ax.imshow(im.crop(boxes[kind]),interpolation='nearest');ax.set_axis_off();ax.set_title(f'{case} / f{frame}')
 fig.suptitle(f'{kind}: pre-detector scene controls; agent provisional roles only')
 fig.savefig(out/f'{kind}-controls.png',dpi=120);plt.close(fig)
for name,pin in pre['inputs'].items():assert sha(root/name)==pin,name
(out/'display-receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(preflight_sha256=sha(out/'preflight.json'),inputs_preserved=True,outputs={str(p.relative_to(root)):sha(p) for p in sorted(out.glob('*.png'))},script=Path(__file__).read_text()),indent=2)+'\n')
print(out)

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib
import json

root = Path('/Users/sunjaekim/Developer/oil_level_tracker')
local = root / 'sample/output/s11-public-scene-controls-20261009-001'
sha = lambda p: hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
preflight = json.loads((local / 'preflight.json').read_text())
receipt = json.loads((local / 'display-receipt.json').read_text())
intake = json.loads((root / 'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-intake.json').read_text())
rename = json.loads((root / 'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-video-rename.json').read_text())
aliases = {v['current_path']: v for v in rename['renames']}
videos = {v['path']: v for v in intake['overview']['videos']}

readings = {
    's5-empty': (
        'Empty-looking glass interior, fixed rim and patterned base.',
        'Structure opposition and same-scene context before filling.',
        'No canonical EMPTY phase or per-pixel structure mask; appearance can change under refraction.'),
    's5-inclined': (
        'A large inclined upper bubbly-water feature during pouring; agent leans toward a displaced surface, but splash-sheet alternative remains.',
        'UNRESOLVED: either protect real surface deformation or oppose following a separate splash sheet.',
        'Human interpretation pending; neither a positive nor negative physical-control label is assigned.'),
    's5-settled': (
        'Comparatively settled visible upper liquid surface, with bubbles below and persistent glass pattern.',
        'Provisional visible-surface context with glass and internal-bubble opposition.',
        'No scalar, exact contour, or cross-frame point correspondence is certified.'),
    's6-empty': (
        'Empty-looking glass with a thick fixed base, rim and reflections.',
        'Static structure opposition before liquid/Foam formation.',
        'No canonical EMPTY phase or whole-image negative label.'),

        'Early frothy layer and upper surface; turbulent, diffuse lower transition.',
        'Separate layer presence, upper-front visibility and lower-interface availability.',
        'Do not manufacture two clean contours from a diffuse forming region.'),

        'Visible liquid–Foam transition; upper Foam–air surface is outside the original source image.',

    's7-empty': (
        'Empty-looking glass with visible rim and base.',
        'Same-scene fixed-structure opposition before opaque liquid arrives.',
        'No canonical EMPTY phase, exact support mask or certified camera alignment.'),
    's7-pouring': (
        'Opaque white liquid body, incoming stream and frothy/splash-like surface features.',
        'Bulk-white-liquid versus Foam opposition, with stream/surface alternatives.',
        'Do not classify the entire white body as Foam or the whole video as Foam-negative.'),
    's7-settled': (
        'Settled white body with a thin bubbly/frothy top region.',
        'Upper-surface context and uncertain internal milk/froth separation.',
        'Exact milk/froth dividing contour remains unknown; bright-body extrema are not physical truth.'),
}

cases = []
for selected in preflight['selection']:
    alias = aliases[selected['video']]
    video = videos[alias['original_path']]
    frame = next(f for f in video['frames'] if f['frame_index'] == selected['frame_index'])
    observed, purpose, limitation = readings[selected['case_id']]
    cases.append({
        **selected,
        'video_sha256': alias['sha256_after'],
        'historical_video_path': alias['original_path'],
        'nominal_playback_time_sec': frame['nominal_time_sec'],
        'source_raster': frame,
        'recording_group': alias['current_path'],
        'partition': 'development',
        'exposure': 'Previously visually inspected native intake frame; no detector predictions viewed.',
        'interpretation_authority': 'agent_provisional',
        'observation': observed,
        'proposed_control_purpose': purpose,
        'limitation': limitation,
        'human_review_status': 'PENDING' if selected['case_id'] == 's5-inclined' else 'NOT_REQUESTED',
        'physical_truth': None,
        'target_role_truth': None,
        'scalar_truth': None,
        'contour_truth': None,
        'packet_binding': None,
    })

for path, pin in preflight['inputs'].items():
    assert sha(root / path) == pin, path
assert receipt['inputs_preserved'] is True
assert receipt['preflight_sha256'] == sha(local / 'preflight.json')
for path, pin in receipt['outputs'].items():
    assert sha(root / path) == pin, path
assert len(cases) == len({c['case_id'] for c in cases}) == 9
assert len({(c['video_sha256'], c['frame_index']) for c in cases}) == 9
assert all(c['source_raster']['frame_index'] == c['frame_index'] for c in cases)
assert all(c['source_raster']['path'] in preflight['inputs'] for c in cases)
assert all(c['source_raster']['sha256'] == preflight['inputs'][c['source_raster']['path']] for c in cases)

record = {

    'cases': cases,

        'integration_limit': 'These owners require actual bound R22-3 candidate packets and physical/target annotations. None exists for this inventory; do not synthesize a packet from provisional scene descriptions.',

    },
    'actions': {

        'detector_run': False,
        'model_fit': False,
        'recipe_change': False,
        'label_change': False,
        'production_code_change': False,
        'acceptance_change': False,
    },
    'packaging_script': Path(__file__).read_text(),
}
destination = root / 'docs/50-diagnostics/s11/2026-10-09-public-scene-controls.json'
with destination.open('x') as handle:
    json.dump(record, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    handle.write('\n')
